evaluation.asset_context: EP01 Beat 1 — cleanroom wafer handling macro shots (18s), inset @ 70%, standard duotone treatment

score_notes.resolution_fit: Exceeds 4K threshold (4000×2667). Can crop and reframe freely without quality loss.
score_notes.aspect_framing: Native landscape, excellent 16:9 ratio, subject centered. Safe framing.
score_notes.treatment_survivability: Professional photographer, landscape composition suggests good light/dark separation. High confidence on duotone performance.
score_notes.script_relevance: Cannot assess content from metadata alone. Professional source + landscape + 4K suggest meaningful composition, but actual cleanroom relevance unknown.
score_notes.diversity: First Pexels result; no diversity bonus in metadata-only scoring.

candidates.recommendation: TIER 1 — Production-ready if preview confirms cleanroom/manufacturing content.

score_notes.resolution_fit: Exceeds 4K (5472×3648 = 8K source). Extreme headroom for cropping.
score_notes.aspect_framing: Native landscape 16:9, excellent ratio. Very safe framing.
score_notes.treatment_survivability: Pixabay archive = stock photography. Without photographer name/style, estimate assumes mid-range contrast. Treatment survivability likely solid but less predictable than named professional.
score_notes.script_relevance: Unknown content. Pixabay generic stock suggests generic tech/industrial (lower confidence on cleanroom specificity).

candidates.recommendation: TIER 1 — Marginally lower confidence than #1 due to unknown photographer style, but highest absolute resolution. Select if preview shows superior macro detail.

score_notes.resolution_fit: 3024×4032 portrait. Can fill 1080p (2.2x the area needed), but orientation matters more than raw pixels.
score_notes.aspect_framing: STRUCTURAL PROBLEM: Portrait orientation (3:4) cropped to 16:9 loses ~40% of vertical content. Subject placement uncertain without preview. High risk of important details in the crop zone.
score_notes.treatment_survivability: Brand 'ThisIsEngineering' strongly suggests technical/manufacturing photography with good contrast. High confidence on treatment, but...
score_notes.script_relevance: Brand name explicitly references engineering. If this is a cleanroom/manufacturing shot, script fit is excellent (score: 4). BUT portrait orientation undermines entire value.

candidates.recommendation: TIER 2 — Only select if preview shows cleanroom content with subject safely positioned in 16:9-safe zone. Otherwise skip due to framing liability. Portrait orientation is a structural problem for video insets.

score_notes.resolution_fit: Exactly 1920×1080 (1:1 match to target video size). No crop headroom. Cannot enlarge without pixelation.
score_notes.aspect_framing: Native landscape 16:9. Framing likely safe, but zero reframing flexibility.
score_notes.treatment_survivability: Flickr archive = documentary/generalist photography. Tonal range uncertain. Moderate confidence on duotone treatment (may be average contrast).
score_notes.script_relevance: Unknown content. Flickr suggests archival/documentary quality but generic stock film.

candidates.recommendation: TIER 3 — Meets minimum specs but zero flexibility. Only use if #1, #2, #3 are all unsuitable and deadlines force a pick. No crop ability = no safety margin.

score_notes.resolution_fit: Below minimum viable threshold. 640px width vs 1920px target = 3x upscaling. Upscaling artifacts will be visible even at small sizes.
score_notes.aspect_framing: Landscape ratio is technically fine, but resolution constraint makes framing irrelevant.
score_notes.treatment_survivability: Low resolution compounds with duotone treatment: upscaling artifacts + reduced tonal gradation = banding and visible noise. Post-treatment will look degraded.
score_notes.script_relevance: Studio credit suggests professional work, but resolution collapse negates any content value.

candidates.recommendation: DISQUALIFY — Resolution is fatal. Never use SD stock in 1080p+ production, especially after duotone treatment amplifies compression artifacts.

summary.recommendation: Select from Tier 1 (#1 or #2) based on preview content assessment. Both are production-ready on technical merits.
summary.alternative_search_strategy: If previews show generic/irrelevant content, recommend broadening search to: 'chip fabrication', 'lithography machine', 'TSMC fab interior', 'wafer manufacturing macro', or commissioning a technical macro shot from Unsplash/professional photographer.
